disposition: Session::save_changes implements the unit of work: puts/deletes/deferred commands staged in V1 batch order until save, one atomic engine transaction per save, committed-state clearing with deleted-document eviction, and failure preserving session state; all focused-tested. Gap: no asynchronous save form exists anywhere (the C# TBEP client's async ops are single-document, not a session unit of work) and the save-event surface is only the on_after_save hook.
